mapper.select: SELECT action, payload_json FROM source_command WHERE enterprise_id=#{enterpriseId} AND warehouse_id=#{warehouseId} AND command_id=#{commandId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE source_outbox SET payload=CAST(#{payload} AS JSON) WHERE enterprise_id=#{enterpriseId} AND warehouse_id=#{warehouseId} AND command_id=#{commandId} AND status='PENDING' AND event_type='StockCommandRequested' AND NOT JSON_CONTAINS_PATH(payload, 'one', '$.postingContext')
